title: JudicialEvent
description: A court ruling that changes whether a provision is enforceable (PROCUREMENT_PLAN §2.2 Table 4), from curated/judicial_events.json

act_id.description: Act containing the provision, resolved against the acts table

provision_path.description: Section slug as in the sections table e.g. 66a, 124a

neutral_citation.description: Neutral citation e.g. 2023 INSC 1; null where none was assigned

reported_citation.description: Law report citation e.g. (2015) 5 SCC 1; null unless verified

effect.description: struck_down/stayed close the provision's in_force slice; read_down and upheld never change status

source_url.description: Stable public page for the ruling
